a recipe ingredient of a mod's own kind
(`native_ingredient`, which the unknown ingredient type in a namespace of
own reaches with the kind, its JSON and the item list to fill).
doc_summary: a recipe ingredient of a mod's own kind. The ingredient entry that names a type in a namespace outside minecraft: reaches native_ingredient(kind, data, items) at load time. Fill items with the item ids the ingredient matches (item ids only: components are not checked; a match-time hook follows separately). Duplicates are removed keeping first-seen order. An unclaimed kind leaves the list empty and the recipe fails. The hook may be called more than once per recipe; the answer must be the same. Bundles that use it need "hooks": @API:ingredient@.
